title: Sutherland Brothers & Quiver - Lifeboat Album Cover
coreRelationships: The small lifeboat is dwarfed by the turbulent waves and the larger, partially obscured steamship, emphasizing vulnerability.
The figures in the lifeboat are actively rowing, creating a sense of urgent motion and struggle against the elements.
The distressed, painterly texture of the entire image unifies the scene and typography into a cohesive vintage aesthetic.
The typography for the band name is large and ornate, contrasting with the smaller, simpler title at the bottom right, creating a clear hierarchy.
